generation.generation_instruction: For each medical imaging modality, write six normal and six abnormal English descriptions for CLIP. Describe only visible intensity, texture, boundary, symmetry, color, and structural cues; preserve modality context; avoid patient metadata and unsupported diagnoses; keep each description to one sentence.
generation.intended_use: normal/abnormal CLIP text anchors for medical anomaly detection
generation.postprocessing: deduplicate, verify normal/abnormal polarity, and retain the exact reviewed text for every experiment
constraints: describe visible imaging appearance rather than a specific diagnosis
avoid claims about pathology not observable in the image
